Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
INEDIBLE OFFALS TROLLEY

1. Scope — Specifies material, dimensions and other requirements for a trolley for transport of 
inedible offals in a meat processing unit or an abattoir. 

2. Material 

2.1 Body and Cover 

a) Galvanized plain steel sheets [see 13:277-1969 Specification for galvanized steel sheets 
(plain and corrugated) {second revision)] of a minimum thickness of 1*60 mm, or mild 
steel sheets [see IS : 226-1969 Specification for structural steel (standard quality) {fourth 
revision )] of a minimum thickness of 1*60 mm; or 

b) Aluminium sheets of minimum thickness of 3 mm. 

2.2 Chassis and Rest — MWd steel (see IS: 226-1969) in the form of angles, bar or tube. 

2.3 Handle Grip — Wood or plastic. 

2.4 Wheel --MWd steel (see IS : 226-1969) or cast iron [see IS : 210-1970 Specification for grey iron 
castings {second revision)] fitted with solid or cushioned rubber tyre (see 13:7369-1974 
Specification for wheels and castors ). 

3. Dimensions — See Fig. 1. 

4. Other Requirements 

4.1 A suitable rest of 300 mm height shall be provided. 

4.2 The chassis shall be suitably reinforced. 

4.3 The axle shall be fixed to the frame of the chassis and the bearings shall be located inside the 
wheel hubs which shall revolve over the axle. 

4.4 The bearings shall be so designed that there is no side play or wobble in the movement of the 
wheels. Adequate arrangements shall be provided to facilitate proper lubrication of bearings. 

5. Workmanship and Finish 

5.1 All steel parts shall be painted properly with a suitable paint to prevent corrosion. 

5.2 The trolley shall be free from pits, burrs and other functional defects. 

6. IWIarking — The trolley shall be marked with the following particulars: 

a) Manufacturer's name, and 

b) Batch or code number. 

6.1 ISI Certification MarA/ng— Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



Adopted 22 December 1975
